source: 大阪市 新規介護保険事業者の指定前の確認について（Q&A）
source_policy: Municipal answers are not used as national ground truth. When a municipal document carries locality only in page context, the authority name may be minimally prefixed to the query so the benchmark preserves information a real user would need to supply for a locality-dependent answer.

initial_local_routing.cause: The classifier recognized explicit local-authority context but its local procedure vocabulary did not yet include broader designation concepts such as becoming a designated provider, pre-designation confirmation, or starting operations after designation.

change.rule: Expand LOCAL procedure vocabulary only when explicit local-authority context is present.
change.safety_boundary: Do not classify the same concepts LOCAL when no municipality / prefecture / designated-authority context is present.

conclusion: Locality is part of answerability. Query provenance must not be discarded when the answer depends on the designated authority.
